judgments.rationale: The proposal modifies the summary of C0002 to restrict inspections regarding traced firearms to 'not more than once during any 12-month period'. Under paragraph (ii), subclauses (I) and (II) are disjunctive alternatives separated by 'or'. Subclause (II) explicitly permits inspections 'at any time with respect to records relating to a firearm involved in a criminal investigation that is traced to the licensee'. Merging the once-per-year limitation of (I) into (II) directly contradicts the source text.

The proposal fills the previously blank action fields of C0002 with 'inspect or examine', directly supported by the text of F000 ('may inspect or examine the inventory and records...'). It fixes a real omission in the draft claim while preserving the correct actor, modality, and scope.
